expo.name: TyraX Cam
expo.//: orientation is switched at RUNTIME (App.js): portrait to type an address, landscape once filming. The plist must therefore allow both, which 'default' does - a static 'landscape' here would veto the portrait lock.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ARKit world tracking needs the camera to work out how the phone moves. The picture is never recorded, shown or sent anywhere - only the position and rotation of the device go to the editor.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: TyraX Cam connects to the TyraX editor running on your computer over the local network.
